verdict.rationale: Gusto's own API fundamentals docs say the API has scopes that govern 'the actions your application can take', so permission-scoped application credentials are documented in principle. But the pack gives no detail on how to issue or limit them for an agent, and API access is restricted to App Integration and Embedded Payroll partners. missing for 10: documentation of how scoped credentials are created and which scopes are available, per-agent or least-privilege token issuance, the scope model for CLI or MCP authentication, open (non-partner) access, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
